// diagnostic

E0180

`{callee}`'s `#{clause}` condition is {answer} for this call while building

What

`{callee}`'s `#{clause}` condition is {answer} for this call while building

Why

A condition written `#run { … }` must be decided while building for every call, from the call's arguments after contract substitution. A false answer, or no answer because it reads a value only known at run time, stops the build at the call.

Fix

Pass arguments the build can read that make the condition true, or drop `#run` so the condition is checked when the program runs.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0180: tests/ui/contract_required_pre_false.stderr.

Error [jet.RequiredContractNotTrue]: `sum`'s `#Pre` condition is false for this call while building
  --> tests/ui/contract_required_pre_false.jet:3:22
    |
  3 | run: fn() { print("{(sum(3, [1, 2, 3]))}") }
    |                      ^^^
 Why: the condition is written `#run { … }`, so every call decides it while building from its arguments
 Fix: pass arguments that make the condition true, or drop `#run` so the condition is checked when the program runs
